summary: Retrieve Node fs.Stats for the link itself rather than following symbolic links.

semantics.return_value: Node-compatible Stats or undefined with throwIfNoEntry:false
semantics.bigint_option: numeric Stats fields can be JS BigInt-compatible

caveats: Using FileInfo on a symlink may expose target-oriented metadata depending on API usage; helper must use link-aware primitives.
Windows reparse points and POSIX symlinks are not identical.

tests.name: reports symlink itself
tests.expected_behavior: returns stats for the symbolic link itself and isSymbolicLink() is true

tests.name: differs from stat
tests.expected_behavior: lstat does not follow the link while stat does
